name: Four Points by Sheraton Surabaya, Tunjungan Plaza
short_description: Select-service Four Points by Sheraton in central Surabaya's Tunjungan business district, connected directly to Tunjungan Plaza, East Java's largest shopping and entertainment mall.
ai_summary: Four Points by Sheraton Surabaya, Tunjungan Plaza is a select-service Marriott Bonvoy hotel in the heart of Surabaya's Tunjungan business district, physically connected to Tunjungan Plaza, East Java's largest shopping and entertainment complex. The property offers roughly 293 rooms and suites with the brand's signature Four Comfort Bed, floor-to-ceiling windows, free Wi-Fi and 24-hour room service, plus an outdoor pool, a 24-hour fitness centre, nine meeting rooms and a ballroom aimed at business and MICE travelers. Guests and video reviewers consistently praise the unbeatable location and direct mall access, the friendly and attentive service, clean and comfortable rooms, and a generous breakfast spread mixing Western and Indonesian dishes at the Lime restaurant. Marriott Bonvoy members frequently note that elite status is recognized and benefits honored. As a Four Points property it is comfortable rather than luxurious, and there is no dedicated executive lounge, so elite recognition centers on breakfast and room perks rather than a club experience. Recurring watch-outs from reviews include variable soundproofing and occasional Wi-Fi inconsistency, plus the usual congestion and parking pressure of a busy mall-integrated city hotel. Note this is the central Tunjungan Plaza property and is distinct from the newer Four Points by Sheraton Surabaya at Pakuwon Indah in the western suburbs. Overall it rates strongly on TripAdvisor and OTA aggregates and is a dependable, well-located choice for shopping-focused leisure stays and downtown business trips.

core_facts.address: Jl. Embong Malang 25-31, Tunjungan Plaza, Tegalsari, Surabaya, East Java 60261, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Room upgrades for Platinum Elite and above, subject to availability (select-service upgrade pool)
Bonus points in lieu of breakfast for Platinum Elite and above at hotels without full breakfast service
Enhanced Wi-Fi and a welcome amenity for all Elite tiers

pros: Direct indoor connection to Tunjungan Plaza, East Java's largest mall, with dining, cinema and retail steps from the lobby
Central Tunjungan business-district location close to Surabaya's downtown offices and landmarks
Consistently friendly, attentive service and reliable Marriott Bonvoy status recognition
Clean, comfortable rooms with the Four Comfort Bed and a well-reviewed Western and Indonesian breakfast spread
cons: Variable soundproofing means some rooms pick up noise from corridors or the surrounding area
Wi-Fi performance is reported as inconsistent by some guests
As a Four Points, there is no executive lounge and the amenity set is functional rather than luxurious
research_highlights: Ranks around #6 of 213 hotels in Java on TripAdvisor with a 4.0/5 aggregate from roughly 1,800 traveler reviews
Roughly 293 rooms and suites plus nine meeting rooms and a ballroom, with direct access to Tunjungan Plaza mall
Strong OTA scores (Booking.com ~9.0/10, Trip.com ~9.5/10) reinforcing its reputation for location and service
research_watchouts: Do not confuse this central Tunjungan Plaza hotel with the separate Four Points by Sheraton Surabaya at Pakuwon Indah in the western suburbs
Being integrated with a major mall means busy public areas and parking pressure, and rooms can vary in noise levels

faqs.question: Is the hotel really connected to Tunjungan Plaza?
faqs.answer: Yes. The hotel occupies part of the Tunjungan Plaza complex and has direct indoor access to the mall, East Java's largest shopping and entertainment destination. Guests can reach hundreds of shops, restaurants, a cinema and supermarkets without stepping outside, which is the property's single biggest draw.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from Juanda International Airport?
faqs.answer: Juanda International Airport (SUB) sits roughly 18 kilometers southeast of the hotel in central Surabaya. Depending on traffic the drive typically takes about 30 to 45 minutes. The hotel can arrange airport transfers, and taxis or ride-hailing apps are widely available throughout the city.

faqs.question: Does this Four Points have an executive lounge for Bonvoy elites?
faqs.answer: No. As a Four Points by Sheraton it does not operate a dedicated executive or club lounge. Marriott Bonvoy elite members are generally recognized through complimentary breakfast, room upgrades where available and points bonuses rather than a lounge, and reviewers note status is honored consistently.
